source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the singular tree on both sides and the twelve/monthly relation without resolving the spatial image.
key_decisions.before: through the middle of the street of the city. On either side of the river is the tree of life with its twelve kinds of fruit, producing its fruit each month, and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
key_decisions.after: down the middle of the city's street. On either side of the river was the tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, yielding its fruit each month. The tree's leaves are for the healing of the nations.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: through the middle of the street of the city. On either side of the river is the tree of life with its twelve kinds of fruit, producing its fruit each month, and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the curse's removal, shared throne and singular his/him with explicit slaves.
key_decisions.before: No longer will there be anything accursed, but the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will worship him.
key_decisions.after: There will no longer be anything accursed. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his slaves will serve him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: No longer will there be anything accursed, but the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will worship him.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned spirits of the prophets and preserves the opening book's disclosure language.
key_decisions.before: And he said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true. And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place.”
key_decisions.after: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to show his slaves what must happen soon.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And he said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true. And the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the unsettling fourfold imperatives and repeated still without smoothing them into description.
key_decisions.before: Let the evildoer still do evil, and the filthy still be filthy, and the righteous still do right, and the holy still be holy.”
key_decisions.after: Let the one who does wrong still do wrong; let the filthy still be filthy; let the righteous still practice righteousness; and let the holy still be holy.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let the evildoer still do evil, and the filthy still be filthy, and the righteous still do right, and the holy still be holy.”

key_decisions.rationale: Follows wash robes rather than do commandments and retains access to tree and gates.
key_decisions.before: Blessed are people who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by the gates.
key_decisions.after: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and enter the city through its gates.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by the gates.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows tree of life rather than book of life and keeps the reciprocal removal.
key_decisions.before: and if someone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book.
key_decisions.after: If anyone takes away from the words of the scroll of this prophecy, God will take away that person's share in the tree of life and in the holy city described in this scroll.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned short ending with all, without adding Christ, saints or a final Amen.
key_decisions.before: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all. Amen.
key_decisions.after: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all. Amen.
